row.scim_price_text: Included; plans start at $500/month (Customer Knowledge Engine)
row.team_price_text: Starts at $500/month (annual term, no seat pricing)
row.evidence: Totango's help article on managing system users via the SCIM API is marked 'Available on all plans', as is its Okta provisioning guide.
row.notes: Totango rebranded as Odie (totango.com says 'Totango is now Odie'); the Totango app continues as the Customer Operating System on top of the Customer Knowledge Engine. Odie publishes only starting prices (Knowledge Engine from $500/month, Customer Operating System from $1,500/month; annual terms, no seat-based pricing), so per-user fields are null. The SCIM and SSO help articles (support.totango.com) say 'Available on all plans'; they predate the Odie packaging. SCIM 2.0 endpoint per service; deactivation via active=false (disabled users stop counting toward licence allocation); deletion not supported over SCIM. Okta OIN app provisions (create, update, deactivate).

plans.name: Customer Knowledge Engine
plans.notes: Priced on knowledge maintenance and MCP access; no seats. Help-centre 'Available on all plans' labels predate this packaging.

plans.name: Customer Operating System
plans.notes: Successor of the Totango customer success app; runs on top of the Knowledge Engine. SSO/SCIM backed by Totango help articles marked 'Available on all plans'.

auth.token_source: Profile > Edit Profile > Integrations > create a new token (app-token), or OAuth client-credentials token from /oauth2/api/v1/token using a global admin's credentials
auth.token_expiry: OAuth token 86400 seconds; app-token expiry not stated

deprovision.data_retained: Disabled users keep their profile and can be activated again; only deletion (UI) removes system access and profile.

custom.how: Totango extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:totango:1.0:User with isActive, license (Spark/Zoe), isAdmin, managerEmail, managerExternalId; groups carry teamrole.

roles.how: isAdmin (global admin) and license in the Totango extension schema; team role via groups[].teamrole.

rate_limits.text: Global API rate limit of 100 calls/minute per token (stated on the Audit log API article: 'Like all APIs').

limitations.text: User deletion is not supported via the SCIM API.
Okta: custom group attributes not supported; licence must be a user attribute.
Filtering works on one field only (userName or externalId).
Tokens must belong to a global admin.

user_api.notes: Totango's documented system-user API is the SCIM API itself (recorded under scim); no separate non-SCIM user-management API was found.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (SAML not ticked, but the overview mentions SSO).

fallbacks.other_sync: Customer Data Hub file integration can create and update Totango users.
fallbacks.notes: Salesforce SSO can optionally admit any Salesforce org user, but SAML users must exist first.
